state_definitions.interrupted: Durable runtime records show work stopped mid-flight and no continuity decision has been durably recorded yet.
state_definitions.resume_ready: A replay-safe durable checkpoint exists, so continuity may resume from checkpoint truth.
state_definitions.rerun_ready: Resume is not authorized or not possible; restart must occur from a clean rerun or focused revalidation boundary.
state_definitions.repairing: A bounded repair is allowed, but repair may only prepare the next rerun or focused revalidation step.
state_definitions.blocked: Continuation is intentionally held for operator or dependency action instead of being guessed.
state_definitions.fail_closed: Continuity cannot be proven safely from durable facts, so the system must stop without promoting truth.

outcome_definitions.resume: Resume from durable checkpoint truth without inventing new work.
outcome_definitions.rerun: Launch a fresh rerun or focused revalidation from an explicit boundary.
outcome_definitions.repair_then_rerun: Apply a bounded repair, then rerun or focused revalidate before any later promotion.
outcome_definitions.operator_block: Stop and surface the block explicitly for operator or dependency handling.
outcome_definitions.fail_closed: Stop because the durable facts are insufficient or conflicting.
